request.tone: gentle wonder and courage in tidal sea caves; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: catalog book; plan extracted by reading the book, no request exists

pitch.hero: Maya, a girl exploring the sea caves under her aunt's lighthouse with her dog Biscuit
pitch.want: to find what waits behind the three echoing cave mouths
pitch.obstacle: about an hour of low tide before the sea seals the caves, plus slick rock, rising water and a ladder
pitch.stake: a real discovery to bring home, or a safe retreat before the tide closes in
pitch.ending_kind: ten wonder finds (treasures, secret places) or six safe setback retreats to try another low tide

maya.name: Maya
maya.want: to explore the echoing sea caves and bring home a real discovery
maya.voice: close third present; curious, careful, brave in measured steps, quick to choose safety

biscuit.name: Biscuit
biscuit.want: to sniff ahead and stay close to Maya
biscuit.voice: no speech; tail, ears, whines and barks

aunt.name: Maya's aunt
aunt.want: for Maya to explore the cove only until the tide turns

truth.statement: Three sea-cave mouths below the lighthouse kept by Maya's aunt open for about an hour of low tide before the sea seals them. Behind them lie real wonders: a crystal grotto and a singing chamber, a lost ship's bell, a hidden lake with a glowing islet, a secret tide-pool, a bat roost under a meadow skylight, and a smuggler's cache. Turning back before the tide always brings Maya out safe.
truth.question: What waits inside the three echoing sea caves before the tide comes back?

maya_explorer.text: Maya is a girl who ducks under the lighthouse rocks to explore the sea caves for {HERO}.

biscuit_companion.text: Biscuit, Maya's dog, follows at her heels into the caves.

lighthouse_above_cove.text: A lighthouse stands on the rocks above the cove and its sea caves.

aunt_knows_plan.text: Maya's aunt knows they are exploring the cove until the tide turns.

tide_going_out.text: The tide is pulling back from the sea caves as Maya arrives.

three_mouths.text: Three dark openings in the cliff breathe out cool air.

left_hums.text: The left cave mouth hums, warm and low.

right_drips.text: The right cave mouth drips, slow and steady.

middle_whispers.text: Something almost whispers in the dark of the opening straight ahead.

tide_deadline.text: Maya has about an hour before the sea comes back and seals every cave mouth shut.

maya_has_torch.text: Maya has a torch with her.

maya_has_notebook.text: Maya carries a notebook in her pocket.

left_glow_rustle.text: Past a bend in the low humming tunnel a soft light glows and a rustle like wind through paper drifts back.

left_fork_glitter.text: The humming tunnel splits; one way a wall glitters with tiny specks like small stars.

left_fork_murmur.text: At the split the other way's hum grows warmer, like a voice murmuring nearby.

quartz_wall.text: The glittering wall is studded with tiny bits of quartz that throw back the torchlight.

slope_to_crack.text: Past the quartz wall the floor slopes down toward a narrow crack that sighs cold air.

blue_crack_room.text: The slope opens into a small round room where a crack in the wall glows with soft blue light.

water_pooling_crack.text: Cold water seeps in from deep in the rock and pools around Maya's boots by the glowing crack.

left_pool_retreat.text: Maya turned back from the glowing crack and splashed out to the mouth as the sea crept halfway up the rocks.

promise_next_low_tide.text: Maya promises Biscuit they will come back to the caves at the next low tide.

plans_return.text: Maya is already planning to come back to the caves on another day or low tide.

squeezed_through_crack.text: Maya and Biscuit squeezed sideways through the glowing crack into open space.

shimmering_room_ahead.text: Just past the crack a wide room shimmers with bright blue light.

crystal_grotto.text: The shimmering room is a grotto whose walls hold glowing blue crystals.

loose_crystal.text: One loose glowing crystal wobbles in its stone socket at Maya's eye level.

humming_archway.text: Deeper in the grotto a rounded archway hums with a low sound.

maya_has_crystal.text: Maya has the glowing blue crystal from the grotto.

passage_to_lighthouse.text: The crystal's light shows a low passage curving up toward the lighthouse.

door_behind_lighthouse.text: A narrow stone stair from the caves ends at a little wooden door tucked behind the old lighthouse.

out_in_evening.text: Maya comes out of the caves in the evening light.

home_folk.text: Maya has people back home she wants to show or tell about her find.

shell_walls.text: Past the archway the crystals give way to smooth ribbed walls like the inside of a shell, shaped to carry sound.

ringing_chamber.text: The ribbed passage opens into a vast dim round chamber where every sound rings back like a choir.

chamber_sings.text: The chamber sings Maya's single note back to her, layered and shimmering.

keepers_secret.text: Maya thinks only the lighthouse keepers of long ago knew of the singing chamber.

murmur_is_ringing.text: The warm murmur is not wind but a low, even ringing like a bell struck far below.

chime_below.text: The ringing becomes a deep chime from a lit chamber below, where something metal flashes.

rope_ladder.text: An old rope ladder, left long ago, hangs down into the chiming chamber and holds firm.

left_hum_retreat.text: Maya left the rope ladder unclimbed and reached the mouth safe as the sea began lapping the entrance stones.

ships_bell.text: A huge old ship's bell, green with age, hangs from a stone arch and rings softly as drips strike its rim.

bell_ship_name.text: Letters cast in the bell's lip spell the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago.

lantern_rope_ledge.text: Behind the bell a rusted lantern and a coil of good rope sit forgotten on a dry ledge.

name_in_notebook.text: Maya has copied the lost ship's name into her notebook.

lantern_candle.text: The rusted lantern still holds a stub of old candle.

maya_has_lantern_rope.text: Maya carries the old lantern and the coil of rope.

town_will_hear.text: Maya expects the whole town to gather to hear her story.

home_near_sea.text: Maya's home is near the sea where the caves lie.

dripping_trickle.text: The right passage has glistening black walls, a trickle of water along the floor, and colder air tasting of salt.

right_fork_lapping.text: Where the trickle splits, one way carries a slow hollow lapping like something large and still.

right_fork_briny.text: The other way is a low narrow side-tunnel with a sharp briny smell.

pebble_passage.text: The lapping passage turns to wet pebbles under a ceiling the torch cannot reach.

black_lake.text: Beyond a rock shelf lies an underground lake of black, still water that vanishes into the dark.

slick_shelf.text: The rock shelf narrows and turns slick with green weed above the lake, with a pale shore below.

lake_retreat.text: Maya backed off the weed-slick shelf and retraced the dripping passage safely to the mouth.

gravel_shore.text: Maya climbed down to a pale gravel shore beside the lake.

dark_shape_shore.text: Something long and dark rests half out of the water on the gravel shore.

rowboat.text: The dark shape is an old wooden rowboat, cracked in places but whole.

glowing_shallows.text: Further along the shore the shallow water glows faintly from beneath.

boat_seaworthy.text: The rowboat still has its oars lashed inside and floats steady once its rainwater is tipped out.

lake_crossed_chimney.text: Maya rowed across the lake to a rock shelf where a stone chimney led up to dune grass and open sky.

first_in_lifetime.text: Maya believes they are the first people in a lifetime to cross the hidden lake.

glowing_shells.text: Thousands of tiny pale shells glow in the shallows and lead toward a bright opening.

glowing_islet.text: The shells lead to a tiny white-sand islet ringed by glowing water and lit by a shaft of sky.

maya_has_shells.text: Maya has tucked a few pale shells into her pocket.

islet_kept_secret.text: Maya promises to keep the shining islet a secret.

briny_crawl.text: The briny side-tunnel is so tight that Maya must crawl while Biscuit trots ahead toward a pale light.

clear_channel.text: The tunnel widens under hanging weed, and a shallow channel of clear seawater runs toward a rounded chamber.

weed_curtain.text: The channel leads to a curtain of hanging weed with bright watery light beyond.

channel_filling.text: Behind Maya the channel is already filling with the tide.

pool_retreat.text: Maya hurried back through the rising channel and burst out at the mouth as the sea poured in.

hidden_tide_pool.text: Beyond the weed curtain is a bright hidden tide-pool lit from above, with anemones and darting silver fish.

orange_starfish.text: A rare cushion starfish glows deep orange in a corner of the tide-pool.

never_seen_starfish.text: Maya has never seen anything like the cushion starfish before.

seen_starfish_before.text: Maya has seen a starfish like the cushion starfish before.

crab_tracks_basin.text: Small crab tracks lead to a deeper, darker basin in the rock.

starfish_sketched.text: Maya has sketched the starfish carefully in her notebook.

starfish_left.text: Maya left the starfish where it clings to the rock.

starfish_taken.text: Maya took the starfish from the pool.

rockpool_club.text: Maya belongs to a rockpool club back home.

pale_thing_basin.text: Something smooth and pale gleams half-buried at the bottom of the murky green basin.

maya_has_spiral_shell.text: Maya has a perfect spiral shell as big as two hands, pearled pink inside.

finest_find.text: The spiral shell is the finest thing Maya has ever found.

whisper_is_draft.text: The whispering echo is only a draft of air sighing over cold stone.

dark_fork_squeak.text: Where the dark passage forks, one branch carries a papery squeaking and flutter.

dark_fork_creak.text: The other branch carries the slow creak of old wood, with a glint of rusted iron.

hanging_shapes.text: Under a high ceiling hundreds of small folded shapes hang, twitching in their sleep.

bat_roost.text: The shapes are hundreds of bats roosting in a warm, earthy, vaulted chamber.

grey_light_roof.text: A faint circle of grey light shows through a gap high in the bat chamber's roof.

shaft_way_out.text: The grey light comes from a narrow shaft in the roof that might lead out of the caves.

bats_never_touched.text: Maya knows the bats are wild animals she must never touch.

bats_left_sleeping.text: Maya backed away from the roost and came out safe while the bats slept on.

bats_kind_choice.text: Maya feels she made the kind choice by leaving the bats in peace.

ask_aunt_tomorrow.text: Maya decides to ask her aunt tomorrow about the roost waking at night.

bats_undisturbed.text: Not a single bat stirs as Maya and Biscuit cross beneath the roost.

bats_woken.text: The bat roost woke as Maya crossed beneath it.

rock_staircase.text: Beneath the shaft, fallen rock forms a rough staircase climbing toward daylight.

carved_arrow.text: Halfway up the chimney an old carved arrow and faded initials show someone climbed it long before.

mossy_funnel.text: The stair narrows into a damp mossy funnel with grass-scented air pouring down.

meadow_exit.text: The chimney comes out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow above the lighthouse.

forgotten_way_in.text: The meadow hole is a forgotten way into the caves above a bat colony nobody seems to have noticed in years.

museum_hopes.text: Maya imagines a museum taking an interest in what she found.

staves_and_door.text: Broken barrel staves litter the floor near a leaning grey plank door with weeping rusted nails, wedged in a side-cave.

hidden_hollow.text: Behind the plank door is a dry hollow walled off by hand long ago as a hiding place, with stacked crates.

smuggler_cache.text: The hollow is an old smuggler's cache forgotten for a hundred years.

hollow_flooding.text: The tide is turning and the hollow's floor already glistens with creeping water.

cache_retreat.text: Maya marked the cache in her memory and reached the mouth safe as the water began lapping the entrance.

crates_rotted.text: Most of the cache's crates have rotted to soft splinters.

two_dry_boxes.text: Two smaller boxes sit whole and unbroken on a dry stone shelf in the cache.

brass_compass_box.text: The first box holds a green-crusted brass compass.

rattling_box.text: The second, heavier box rattles like a handful of loose coins.

carry_one_box.text: Maya can carry only one box out cleanly before the tide catches up.

maya_has_compass.text: Maya has the smuggler's brass compass.

compass_true.text: The old compass needle still swings true and finds north.

maya_has_coin_box.text: Maya has the heavy box of smuggler's coins.

coins_silver_faces.text: The box is full of blackened old silver coins stamped with strange faces.

coins_uncounted.text: Maya has not stopped to count the coins.

coins_counted.text: Maya has counted the smuggler's coins.

n_open.event: Maya and Biscuit slip under the lighthouse rocks as the tide goes out and find three cave mouths, each with its own sound.

n_start.event: With about an hour before the tide seals the caves, Maya switches on her torch, checks her notebook, and picks a sound to follow.

la_tunnel.event: The left passage narrows to a humming tunnel; a glow and a papery rustle wait past a bend.

la_fork.event: The humming tunnel splits between a glittering wall and a warmer murmur, and the tide is turning.

la_glitter.event: The glittering wall is studded with quartz; the floor slopes down toward a crack breathing cold air.

la_glitter2.event: The slope opens into a quiet round room where a crack glows with soft blue light.

la_grotto_app.event: The glowing crack is just wide enough to squeeze through, but cold water is pooling around Maya's boots.

la_retreat_pool.event: Maya turns back from the crack and splashes out to the mouth as the sea rises, promising to return at the next low tide.

la_squeeze.event: Maya and Biscuit squeeze through the crack toward a bright shimmering room.

la_grotto.event: The room is a glowing crystal grotto with a loose crystal at eye level and a humming archway deeper in.

la_crystal_take.event: Maya takes the loose crystal, and its light reveals a passage curving up toward the lighthouse.

la_crystal_out.event: The crystal lights a stair to a door behind the lighthouse; Maya steps into the evening holding a real cave crystal.

la_crystal_deeper.event: Through the archway the hum swells to a chord as ribbed, shell-like walls replace the crystals.

la_song_app.event: The ribbed walls open into a vast round chamber where every sound echoes like a choir.

la_song.event: Maya sings one note and the chamber sings it back; she climbs out humming it all the way home.

la_hum.event: Following the warm murmur, Maya realizes it is a ringing like a bell struck far below.

la_hum2.event: The ringing becomes a deep chime rising from a lit chamber below where metal flashes.

la_bell_app.event: An old rope ladder hangs into the chiming chamber, but time before the tide is short.

la_hum_back.event: Maya decides the chime can wait and climbs back to the mouth safely as the sea begins to lap the entrance.

la_bell.event: At the bottom of the ladder hangs a huge green ship's bell, rung softly by drips.

la_bell2.event: The bell carries the name of a ship lost a hundred years ago; a lantern and rope sit behind it.

la_bell3.event: Maya copies the ship's name into her notebook and gathers the old lantern and rope.

la_bell4.event: With the ship's name in her notebook and the lantern and rope, Maya climbs out into gold evening light, picturing the town hearing her story.

ra_drip.event: The right passage is wet, black and cold, with a salty trickle leading deeper.

ra_fork.event: The trickle reaches a split between a hollow lapping and a briny side-tunnel.

ra_lake_way.event: The lapping passage turns to wet pebbles as the ceiling lifts out of torch reach.

ra_lake2.event: Past the pebbles a rock shelf edges a black, still underground lake.

ra_lake_app.event: The shelf narrows and turns weed-slick above the lake; Maya must climb down or back off.

ra_lake_back.event: Maya backs off the slick shelf and retraces the dripping passage safely to the mouth.

ra_descend.event: Maya climbs down to a pale gravel shore where something long and dark lies half out of the water.

ra_lakeshore.event: The shape is an old rowboat; further along, the shallows glow from beneath.

ra_boat.event: The rowboat still has its oars and floats steady; Biscuit hops in.

ra_row.event: Maya rows across the hidden lake to a stone chimney and climbs out into dune grass and open sky.

ra_wade.event: Maya wades into the glowing shallows, where thousands of tiny shells light a trail.

ra_islet.event: The shells lead to a sky-lit islet; Maya pockets a few shells and promises to keep the place secret.

ra_pool_way.event: Maya crawls through the tight briny side-tunnel behind Biscuit toward a pale light.

ra_pool2.event: The tunnel widens under hanging weed and a clear seawater channel runs toward a chamber.

ra_pool_app.event: A weed curtain hides a bright light ahead while the channel behind fills with the tide.

ra_pool_back.event: Maya hurries back through the rising channel and bursts out at the mouth just as the sea pours in.

ra_pool_enter.event: Through the weed curtain lies a bright hidden tide-pool full of anemones and silver fish.

ra_pool_chamber.event: In the tide-pool a rare orange cushion starfish glows, and crab tracks lead to a dark basin.

ra_starfish.event: Maya sketches the starfish in her notebook, leaves it on its rock, and slips out.

ra_starfish2.event: Maya leaves with a notebook full of starfish drawings for her rockpool club back home.

ra_pool_deep.event: In the murky green basin something smooth and pale gleams half-buried in sand.

ra_pool_deep2.event: Maya lifts out a perfect pink-pearled spiral shell and carries it into daylight like a trophy.

da_dark.event: Down the darkest passage the whisper proves to be only a draft over cold stone.

da_fork.event: The dark passage forks between a papery squeaking and the creak of old wood and rusted iron.

da_bat_way.event: Under a high ceiling hundreds of small folded shapes hang, twitching in sleep.

da_bat2.event: The shapes are hundreds of roosting bats; grey light shows through a gap high in the roof.

da_bat_app.event: The grey light is a roof shaft that might lead out, but reaching it means passing under the sleeping roost.

da_bat_back.event: Maya backs away and leaves the bats sleeping, glad of the kind choice, and plans to ask her aunt about them.

da_bat_enter.event: Maya and Biscuit cross under the roost without a bat stirring and find a fallen-rock stair under the shaft.

da_roost.event: Halfway up the stair Maya finds an old carved arrow and faded initials.

da_roost2.event: The stair narrows into a mossy funnel; Maya boosts Biscuit up and climbs toward green light.

da_skylight.event: Maya climbs out through a hidden hole in the clifftop meadow, a forgotten way into the caves above an unnoticed bat colony.

da_cache_way.event: Following the creak, Maya finds barrel staves and a leaning plank door wedged into a side-cave.

da_cache2.event: Behind the door is a hand-walled hiding hollow full of stacked crates.

da_cache_app.event: It is a century-old smuggler's cache, but the hollow floor is already wet with the turning tide.

da_cache_back.event: Maya marks the cache in memory and beats the rising tide back to the mouth.

da_cache_enter.event: Most crates have rotted, but two small boxes sit whole on a dry shelf.

da_cache_room.event: One box holds a brass compass, the other rattles with coins, and Maya can carry only one out before the tide.

da_compass.event: Maya wipes the compass clean, finds it still true, and follows Biscuit out ahead of the tide.

da_compass2.event: Biscuit leads Maya out as the sea rushes in, a real smuggler's compass in her hand.

da_coins.event: The box is full of blackened silver coins; uncounted, Maya hefts it and hurries for the passage.

da_coins2.event: Maya lugs the box of coins into daylight just ahead of the tide and pictures a museum displaying them.

c_da_push.intent: push up through the mossy funnel

c_cacheenter.intent: step in for a quick look
c_cacheenter.cost: spends scarce tide time on a wet floor

c_cacheback.intent: leave the cache and beat the tide

la_retreat_pool.gift: a safe, laughing escape and a promise to try the glowing crack at the next low tide

la_crystal_out.gift: a real glowing crystal and a secret stair that leads up behind the lighthouse

la_song.gift: the wonder of a chamber that sings one note back as a choir

la_hum_back.gift: a safe return and a ringing mystery left to chase on a safer day

la_bell4.gift: a lost ship's name, an old lantern and rope, and a story the whole town will want

ra_lake_back.gift: a sensible retreat from a slick shelf, with the black lake still waiting

ra_row.gift: a rowboat crossing of a hidden lake and a chimney up into the dunes

ra_islet.gift: a glowing islet of shells kept as a secret, with a few shells to take home

ra_pool_back.gift: a thrilling race against the tide, won, and a reason to come back

ra_starfish2.gift: a careful sketch of a rare starfish, left unharmed, for the rockpool club

ra_pool_deep2.gift: a great pink-pearled spiral shell, the finest find of her life

da_bat_back.gift: the pride of a kind choice and a question about the roost for her aunt

da_skylight.gift: a forgotten way into the caves and a hidden bat colony under the meadow

da_cache_back.gift: a smuggler's cache marked in memory for a drier day

da_compass2.gift: a true-pointing smuggler's compass and a story the town will beg for

da_coins2.gift: a box of smugglers' coins and a dream of her name on a museum card

notes: The book declares no variables and no choice sets one, so threads is empty; it is a pure time-cave tree of 16 routes.
Biscuit is never called a dog in the text; tail, paws, ears and a bark make it plain, so the plan names him a dog.
Choice labels that only propose an action (take the crystal, take the compass) are recorded as choice establishes, not as assertions of the offering node.
